query: SELECT ds.id, ds.restaurantId, r.name as restaurant_name, r.categoryId, c.name as category_name FROM daily_settings ds JOIN restaurants r ON ds.restaurantId = r.id JOIN categories c ON r.categoryId = c.id WHERE ds.settingDate = CURDATE() ORDER BY ds.id;
